en: Huazheng: Oh no, oh no! The Jin soldiers are in the village and my father is still out in the desert. What do I do now?
I've been itching to deal with these Jin soldiers. Leave them to me.
Huazheng: Thank you! I don't know how I can ever repay you.
Helping those in need is a knight-errant's duty. No need to thank me.
Huazheng: The Seven Freaks of Jiangnan are the masters of my anda - my sworn brother - Guo Jing, and I know them well. If you ever need anything, go to Jiangnan and find them.
Thank you for your kindness, Miss. I'll be on my way.
Seven Freaks: Sorry, someone has kidnapped Guo Jing and we must go after him. Please stand aside.
I hope I can be of some help.
Seven Freaks: Then we thank you. Let's go.
You reach the cliff top.
Cyclone Mei: Who are you lot, and what are you doing here? Get lost!
Guo Jing: Masters! Masters! I'm over here!
Seven Freaks: Cyclone Mei! Let Jing'er go!
Cyclone Mei: Hmph! I still need him to practise the Nine Yin Manual. If you know what's good for you, get lost, or I'll send you all to hell!
Seven Freaks: Hmph! Big talk. Let the Seven Freaks of Jiangnan show you!
Leave it to me.
Cyclone Mei: You win this time because there are more of you. Next time I won't let you off!
Seven Freaks: Thanks for your help. If you ever need us, just say the word.
Seven Freaks: We're taking Jing'er to Jiaxing for the duel. We must be off.
Farewell.
Bandit: Ha ha ha! This little lady's a looker. She'll make me a fine bandit wife!
Village Girl: Help! Help! Kidnappers! Please, good sir, save me!
So these are the animals Brother Liang told me about. Time to teach them a lesson.
You there! Let her go, or you'll be sorry!
Bandit: Where'd this wet-behind-the-ears brat come from? Boys, teach him a lesson.
Bandit: Mercy, sir, mercy! We'll never do it again!
Again? If I ever see you again, there won't be enough left of you to bury. Get lost!
Village Girl: Thank you, hero, for saving my life!
It was nothing. We of the Huashan Sect always stand up for what's right.
Village Girl: The Huashan Sect truly lives up to its name for chivalry!
Going to Yangzhou, sir? The boat is about to leave.
Zhou Botong: Why won't anybody play with me?
Zhou Botong: At last, somebody to play with! That Old Heretic is the best!
Who are you? A ghost!
Zhou Botong: What? I'm a ghost? Ha ha ha! Yes, I'm a ghost! Let's play!
Who are you, really?
Zhou Botong: I'll tell you, and it'll scare you silly! I'm Zhou Botong of the Quanzhen Sect. Impressed now? Ha ha ha!
Never heard of you!
Zhou Botong: Argh! "The Way of Heaven takes from excess to make up the lack; so the empty overcomes the full, the lacking overcomes the excess."
What's that supposed to mean?
Zhou Botong: It's a line from the Nine Yin Manual. You wouldn't understand.
Zhou Botong: I'll tell you a secret. Say that line to the cave door and it opens, and out you go.
Really?
Zhou Botong: Try it if you don't believe me.
"The Way of Heaven takes from excess to make up the lack; so the empty overcomes the full, the lacking overcomes the excess."
The door opens.
Zhou Botong: See? Told you so.
You were right. I'll be going now. Bye-bye!
Zhou Botong: Don't go! If you go, there's no one left to play with me. I'm coming out too!
Zhou Botong: I'll take you somewhere fun. There's a great show on there!
Where?
Zhou Botong: On Mt. Hua. Follow me and you'll see. I'm off first!
Note: The Mount Hua Summit quest triggers on Mt. Hua only once you reach Lv 70.

Dragon Sage: The Blue Dragon Altar guards an altar treasure. Want it? Bring me 6 Wire Mask, 6 Steel Helm and 6 Gold Helm, then challenge me. Not one may be missing, or you'll regret it. And even if you win, whether you get it is up to fate.
Challenge
Leave
You haven't brought enough. I'll keep what you did bring. Come back next time.

Tiger Sage: The White Tiger Altar guards an altar treasure. Want it? Bring me 6 Deity Cuff, 6 Royal Cuff and 6 War Cuff, then challenge me. Not one may be missing, or you'll regret it. And even if you win, whether you get it is up to fate.

Vermilion Sage: The Vermilion Bird Altar guards an altar treasure. Want it? Bring me 6 Soul Cape, 6 Dread Cape and 6 Sky Cape, then challenge me. Not one may be missing, or you'll regret it. And even if you win, whether you get it is up to fate.

Tortoise Sage: The Black Tortoise Altar guards an altar treasure. Want it? Bring me 6 Phoenix, 6 Pegasus and 6 Army Boots, then challenge me. Not one may be missing, or you'll regret it. And even if you win, whether you get it is up to fate.
Huang Yaoshi: You dare intrude on my Peach Blossom Island!
Miss Rong, I'm a disciple of the Beggars' Sect. I've come to ask you to teach me the Dog-Beating Staff.
Huang Rong: The Dog-Beating Staff is one of the Beggars' Sect's secret arts, so I really shouldn't. But since you came all the way to Peach Blossom Island, I'll teach you a little.
Thank you, Miss Rong.
Huang Rong: But first you have to answer my question correctly.
Ask away, Miss Rong.
Huang Rong: "The clear sage, the cloudy worthy" - what is that an old name for?
Wine
Tea
Huang Rong: Clever!
Huang Rong: You don't even know that, and you want to learn the Dog-Beating Staff? Go brush up your IQ and come back.
Hong Qigong: You must be Lv 10 or higher to join the Beggars' Sect.
Hong Qigong: The Beggars' Sect is the biggest sect under heaven. Do you want to join?
Join
Decline
You are now a Beggars' Sect disciple.
Hong Qigong: You must learn to help the weak.
Hong Qigong: What? You want to learn the Dog-Beating Staff? Hmm, I won't teach you that.
Hong Qigong: The Dog-Beating Staff is one of the Beggars' Sect's secret arts. I've only ever taught it to Rong'er. Your foundation is still too shallow. We'll see later.
Rong'er? You mean Huang Yaoshi's daughter, of Peach Blossom Island?
Hong Qigong: The very same.
Hong Qigong: This brocade box holds a map of the lands in the north. Someone must take it to the Capital and present it to the court. Will you go?
Leave it to me
Not up to it
Hong Qigong: Well done. If this helps the fight to resist the Jin, then all your trouble was worth it!
Teaching Elder: I only teach some basic skills.
Teaching Elder: In this life you repay kindness and avenge wrongs, and folk like us should drink wine by the bowl and eat meat by the slab. That's the life!
Elder, I think you're already drunk.
Teaching Elder: Ha ha ha! The drunker, the clearer! The drunker, the merrier! Who is me? Who am I? Ha ha ha ha!
Teaching Elder: Go buy me five famous Jiangnan wines: Huiquan wine, Jinling Spring, Hundred Flower brew, Jade Blossom dew and Shuanggou Daqu. Hurry back!
Elder, I've brought the wine!
Teaching Elder: Good! Good! Come on, brothers, let's all drink!
Teaching Elder: I only teach advanced skills, and you'll need a good martial foundation for them.
Teaching Elder: The sect has urgent business. Hurry and gather intelligence in Dali.
Teaching Elder: Good, well done.
Teaching Elder: The Jin are about to invade the Central Plains in force. It's urgent: take this letter at once to the Beggars' Sect disciples in the Capital.
Teaching Elder: Hmm. They say they'll quietly warn the common folk to be ready.
Clean Elder: The Clean Clothes faction are the Beggars' Sect's true disciples.
Ragged Elder: The Ragged Clothes faction are the Beggars' Sect's true disciples.
Abbot: You must be Lv 10 or higher to join Shaolin Temple.
Abbot: Would you like to join?
You need Lv 21 to learn the next art.
Learned a new art!
You need Lv 31 to learn the next art.
You need Lv 41 to learn the next art.
You need Lv 51 to learn the next art.
You need Lv 61 to learn the next art.
